name: Worldwide USD
oneLiner: WUSD is WSPN's centralized dollar stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 against cash, cash equivalents, and short-term U.S. Treasury bills in segregated accounts.
collateral: Cash, cash equivalents, and short-term U.S. Treasury bills held in segregated accounts; Basel III-inspired 6% liquidity buffer maintained on non-cash reserves
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption through WSPN; fiat minted/burned on deposit/withdrawal with reserves verified by independent third-party audits

genius.notes: WSPN is a BVI-domiciled entity with a stated FinCEN MSB registration and pending BVI VASP application. WUSD terms restrict U.S. persons. The GENIUS Act foreign-exception comparability framework remains in proposed-rulemaking (Treasury FR 2026-06489; comment deadline June 2, 2026) — no foreign registration can yet be granted. No PPSI approval or US authorization of any kind found.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: WSPN issuer, reserve, redemption, and terms materials were reviewed; no token-specific public U.S. GENIUS approval, official application, or registered/comparable foreign-issuer exception source was located for WUSD. The foreign-exception comparability framework remains in proposed rulemaking.

mintAuthority.summary: WUSD (Fireblocks ERC20F UUPS tokens on Ethereum/Polygon/Viction) uses issuer-operated role-gated minting. Full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked histories enumerated on all 3 chains: minters are issuer EOAs, ownerless operation contracts, and a renounced-owner LayerZero OFT on Viction; DEFAULT_ADMIN on every chain is the issuer EOA 0x731Ef…, with upgrade authority held by issuer EOAs.

controls.label: WUSD Ethereum MINTER_ROLE holder (UUPS proxy, admin EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295374: this UUPS proxy (impl 0x7d1367a7…) exposes admin() = 0x0014EB4AC6dd1473B258D088E6ef214b2bcdc53C; eth_getCode on that admin returned no bytecode (issuer-context EOA, consistent with WSPN enterprise key custody). Not a Safe (no Safe selectors; Safe Transaction Service has no record).

controls.label: WUSD Ethereum MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: Ethereum role reconstruction found this no-code account holding MINTER_ROLE; Safe Transaction Service did not identify a Safe.

controls.label: WUSD Ethereum MINTER_ROLE holder (ownerless operations contract)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295374: owner() = 0x0 and the EIP-1967 implementation slot is empty (not a proxy) — an ownerless, non-upgradeable issuer operations contract holding MINTER_ROLE and BURNER_ROLE.

controls.label: WUSD Polygon MINTER_ROLE holder (ownerless operations contract)
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 88326662: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xff5fd9…) = true; owner() = 0x0; EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots both empty (non-upgradeable, ownerless 24KB contract holding MINTER_ROLE and BURNER_ROLE). Surfaced by the full Polygon RoleGranted scan; no RoleRevoked events exist on Polygon.

controls.label: WUSD Viction MINTER_ROLE holder (LayerZero OFT bridge minter, owner renounced)
controls.evidence: At Viction block 109908880: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x2f5a9c…) = true on the Viction WUSD token; owner() on the 47KB LayerZero OFT contract returned 0x0 (ownership renounced — peer/config changes locked); no EIP-1967 admin slot. Minting via this route is gated by inbound LayerZero messages rather than a privileged key.

controls.label: WUSD default admin (all 3 chains)
controls.evidence: hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x731Ef…) = true on Ethereum (block 25295374), Polygon (88326662), and Viction (109908880); eth_getCode returned no bytecode (issuer EOA). DEFAULT_ADMIN can grant any ERC20F role, including MINTER_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE (no UPGRADER_ROLE holder was ever granted on Ethereum or Polygon, so token upgrades there require this admin to first grant the role).

controls.label: WUSD Viction UPGRADER_ROLE + CONTRACT_ADMIN_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: At Viction block 109908880: hasRole(UPGRADER_ROLE, 0x4a4824…) = true (live read); the full Viction RoleGranted scan also shows CONTRACT_ADMIN_ROLE granted to the same address; eth_getCode returned no bytecode (issuer EOA). Holds UUPS upgrade authority over the Viction WUSD token. The Viction token also exposes owner() = 0x42cc0bac… (issuer EOA, no code).

review.evidence: On 2026-06-11, full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked histories enumerated on all 3 chains (Ethereum + Polygon via Blockscout from deployment; Viction via rpc.viction.xyz eth_getLogs from block 0) and confirmed with live hasRole reads. Tokens are Fireblocks ERC20F UUPS proxies (EIP-1967 admin slot 0; upgrade gated by UPGRADER_ROLE). Ethereum (block 25295374): minters = 0x171AC (UUPS proxy whose admin() = EOA 0x0014EB…), 0x1a41b5 (EOA), 0x80c0A (ownerless non-proxy contract); DEFAULT_ADMIN = EOA 0x731Ef; no UPGRADER_ROLE ever granted; no revocations. Polygon (block 88326662): minters = 0x1a41b5 (EOA) and 0xff5fd9… (ownerless non-proxy contract); DEFAULT_ADMIN = 0x731Ef; no UPGRADER_ROLE granted. Viction (block 109908880): minters = 0x1a41b5 (EOA) and LayerZero OFT 0x2f5a9c (owner() = 0x0, renounced); DEFAULT_ADMIN = 0x731Ef (original admin 0x702b4b revoked); UPGRADER+CONTRACT_ADMIN = EOA 0x4a4824; token owner() = EOA 0x42cc0bac. Every privileged key is an issuer-context EOA, consistent with WSPN's centralized issuance model.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: WUSD is a WSPN stablecoin with multichain deployments and LayerZero is available on Viction, one of the checked WUSD chains. Because public materials do not resolve a stronger issuer-native route and the candidate route is LayerZero-style, Pharos classifies the bridge exposure as external lock/mint.
